svg.text: $ pigeon --help
Usage: pigeon [options] [command]
Deliverability-correct transactional email + notifications. It arrives — in the
inbox, not the spam folder.
Options:
-V, --version print pigeon version
-h, --help display help for command
Commands:
verify [options] [domain] dig SPF/DKIM/DMARC + ALIGNMENT out-of-band; never trust a provider's
send-test [options] send a React-Email template in provider TEST MODE with an idempotency
lint [options] <template> static-analyze email HTML for Gmail/Outlook/Preview/Tailwind hazards
stream-check [options] <tag> <provider> transactional|marketing|cold × provider → ALLOW or HARD-REFUSE (O-02
unsubscribe RFC-8058 one-click unsubscribe config (POST-only, opaque IDs, marketi
warmup author a control-loop warmup ramp (watch 421/450, hold on deferral) (
suppress [options] <op> <address> cross-provider hard-bounce/complaint suppression list (JTBD-4, PIT-05
webhook [options] <op> <provider> <payload> validate a bounce/complaint webhook signature → suppress (JTBD-4)
ses-narrative [options] author the SES production-access narrative from implemented handling
migrate the safe provider-migration runbook: export-logs-first, re-verify, wa
notify [options] <channels> multi-channel fan-out email+push+SMS+in-app (Chime folded in)
inbound Cloudflare Email Routing → webhook → gateway (JTBD-9, the G-09 gap-cl
doctor [options] SDK/runtime health: pinned versions, @react-email/render present, key
ask [options] <symptom> diagnose a symptom against the 19 battle-tested scenarios (the ask-th
serve [options] launch the local cockpit (brain / run-log / eval-scores / ask) on :77
help [command] display help for command
